_comment: Round 10 (2026-05-24) curated allow-list of OpenRouter vision-capable models. Edit this file to add/remove models from the Settings dropdown. Costs are best-effort snapshots from OpenRouter pricing as of 2026-05; treat them as a guide, not a billing source of truth.

_format.label: Human-readable name shown in the dropdown
_format.vendor: Inference vendor for the underlying weights
_format.vision: true if this model can read images. Non-vision models are filtered out of the dropdown.
_format.input_cost_per_million_tokens_usd: USD per 1M input tokens (text + image tokens combined; OpenRouter normalises images to token equivalents)
_format.notes: One-line operator note shown under the dropdown
_format.recommended_for: Subset of [primary, fallback, prefilter] indicating where this model shines

models.label: Qwen3-VL 32B Instruct
models.notes: Strong on charts, fast, ~6x cheaper than Claude Sonnet. Round 10 default primary.

models.label: Qwen2.5-VL 72B Instruct
models.notes: Larger, slightly slower, more verbose than Qwen3-VL. Solid backstop.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 4
models.notes: Highest extraction quality, but expensive. Good as a fallback or for low-volume premium runs.

models.label: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
models.notes: Older Claude, very stable. Reliable fallback if Sonnet 4 has rate-limit hiccups.

models.label: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Mid-cost, strong on numeric extraction. Better than Flash but pricier.

models.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Tiny cost, very fast. Default prefilter — good at ‘is this a chart?’ binary task.

models.label: Gemini 2.0 Flash
models.notes: Older Flash. Reliable fallback. Pre-Round-10 default fallback.

models.label: GPT-4o
models.notes: Strong all-rounder. Sometimes mis-extracts numeric levels on dense charts — verify before promoting to primary.

models.label: GPT-4o Mini
models.notes: Cheap GPT-4o variant. Decent prefilter or low-volume fallback.

models.label: Llama 3.2 90B Vision
models.notes: Open-weights. Symmetric pricing. Decent quality but verbose; can over-explain.

models.label: Pixtral Large (Nov 2024)
models.notes: Strong on European-language charts. Less battle-tested on crypto/equities here — evaluate before promoting.
